# Open Finance OS

> Independent community hub for UAE Open Finance: daily observations of the production and sandbox directories, a weekly ecosystem watch, plain-language guides for banks, insurers and TPPs, curated news, and a synthetic Data Sandbox that serves UAE Open Finance v2.1-shaped payloads over static JSON and MCP. Not affiliated with the Central Bank of the UAE (CBUAE), Nebras or Al Tareq. For official positions, cite those sources.

Things to know when you use this site:

- Observatory figures are dated observations of public directory data, refreshed daily. They are not live, and every figure carries its observation date. Quote the date with the number.
- "LFI" (Licensed Financial Institution) is the UAE term for a bank or insurer that exposes data or payment APIs. "TPP" is a Third Party Provider that uses them.
- Everything in the Data Sandbox is fictional. No real customer, account or institution data is used.

## Observatory (dated ecosystem evidence)

- [Observatory](https://openfinance-os.org/observatory/): production-directory registrations and published API metadata, observed daily
- [Ecosystem Watch](https://openfinance-os.org/observatory/watch/): weekly view of standards, directory registrations and public-log traffic, with source dates and reporting windows
- [Latest briefing](https://openfinance-os.org/observatory/briefing/): the most recent saved Watch summary, with its observation date and cutoff
- [API coverage and comparison](https://openfinance-os.org/observatory/coverage/): filter registrations by environment, API family and version, and export the evidence
- [Sandbox environment](https://openfinance-os.org/observatory/sandbox/): the same view for the sandbox directory
- [Datasets](https://openfinance-os.org/observatory/data/): open, citable registry snapshots, daily history and a derived changelog (JSON)
- [Methodology](https://openfinance-os.org/observatory/methodology/): how metrics and status are derived, and their limits

## Data Sandbox (synthetic UAE Open Finance payloads)

- [Explore the Data Sandbox](https://openfinance-os.org/data-sandbox/): pick a fictional customer and read sample accounts, transactions and insurance payloads in the browser
- [Sandbox explorer](https://data-sandbox.openfinance-os.org/): full explorer with field-level mandatory/optional/conditional status taken from the published v2.1 OpenAPI specification
- [Integration guide](https://data-sandbox.openfinance-os.org/src/integrate.html): five ways to get the data — static JSON fixtures, a local HTTP mock, an embeddable iframe, npm/PyPI packages, and an MCP server
- Hosted MCP server: `https://data-sandbox.fly.dev/mcp` (Streamable HTTP, no sign-in). Covers Bank Data Sharing, Insurance (seven lines) and the ATM Locator. Every response carries a `_watermark` field marking it as synthetic.
- Static fixtures follow `https://data-sandbox.openfinance-os.org/fixtures/v1/bundles/{persona}/{lfi_profile}/seed-{n}/{endpoint}.json`. `fixtures/v1/index.json` lists the published personas, profiles and seeds.

## Learn

- [Learn hub](https://openfinance-os.org/learn/): start here
- [Getting started](https://openfinance-os.org/learn/getting-started/): customer benefit, permission, participants and API Hub architecture
- [TPP overview](https://openfinance-os.org/learn/tpp-guide/): what a Third Party Provider does through the UAE API Hub
- [Bank / LFI overview](https://openfinance-os.org/learn/bank-guide/): the LFI's Ozone Connect interface, customer authentication and the API Hub's role
- [API overview](https://openfinance-os.org/learn/api-guide/): consented and client-credentials services, and where the specifications live
- [V2.2 deadline](https://openfinance-os.org/learn/uae-open-finance-v2-2-deadline/): the 31 December 2026 Tier-1 deadline explained
- [Running a back office](https://openfinance-os.org/learn/back-office/): consent operations, disputes, reconciliation, reporting and service levels after go-live
- [Readiness worksheet](https://openfinance-os.org/learn/readiness/): printable worksheet across eight areas
- [FAQ](https://openfinance-os.org/learn/faq/) and [Glossary](https://openfinance-os.org/learn/glossary/)
- Arabic editions (community translations; English is authoritative): [home](https://openfinance-os.org/ar/), [Learn](https://openfinance-os.org/ar/learn/), and the TPP, LFI and API overviews and glossary under /ar/learn/
